name: jarvis-kanban
description: Jarvis Kanban — convention-based kanban boards for actors, projects, and events

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run bundle

languageModelTools.name: jarvis_createKanbanBoard
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new kanban board YAML file for an actor, project, or event. Returns the file path. If ownerName is omitted, resolves the calling actor via jarvis_whoAmI.

boardName.description: Board file name (without .kanban.yaml suffix). Omit for default 'kanban.yaml'.

ownerName.description: Name of the owning actor/project/event. Omit to auto-resolve via jarvis_whoAmI.

languageModelTools.name: jarvis_verifyKanbanSchema
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Validates a kanban board YAML file against the schema and semantic rules. Returns structured errors and warnings.

boardName.description: Board file name (without .kanban.yaml suffix). Omit for default 'kanban.yaml'.

ownerName.description: Name of the owning actor/project/event. Omit to auto-resolve via jarvis_whoAmI.

languageModelTools.name: jarvis_openKanbanBoard
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Opens a kanban board in the webview renderer. If ownerName is omitted, resolves the calling actor via jarvis_whoAmI.

boardName.description: Board file name (without .kanban.yaml suffix). Omit for default 'kanban.yaml'.

ownerName.description: Name of the owning actor/project/event. Omit to auto-resolve via jarvis_whoAmI.

languageModelTools.name: jarvis_updateKanbanItem
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Updates fields on an existing kanban board item by ID. Merges changes into the item, validates status values. If ownerName is omitted, resolves the calling actor via jarvis_whoAmI.

itemId.description: The ID of the item to update.

changes.description: Key-value pairs of fields to update. The 'id' field cannot be changed.

boardName.description: Board file name (without .kanban.yaml suffix). Omit for default 'kanban.yaml'.

ownerName.description: Name of the owning actor/project/event. Omit to auto-resolve via jarvis_whoAmI.
